chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 0599: Ji Ning Flees, The Human Sovereign Suiren Intervenes!
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning is hunted by the Seamless Gate! In a desperate chase through the Void, the oldest human being alive, Suiren Shi, sends 365 Empyrean Gods to his rescue. A cosmic standoff!
og_title: Desolate Era: The Oldest Human Strikes
og_description: Ji Ning's escape triggers a divine intervention. The Human Sovereign Suiren himself dispatches an army to save him, leading to a breathtaking standoff in the Void.
twitter_description: The Godking's plot fails as Suiren sends a legion of Empyrean Gods to rescue Ji Ning. The chase is over, but the war rages on!

lore_anchors.definition: A vast major world created by Suiren from the primordial Chaos, serving as the ultimate sacred land and seat of power for the human race. It is second in size only to Nuwa's own major world.

The oldest and most powerful existence of the human race; the first of the legendary Three Sovereigns. He is a figure of supreme, nearly unfathomable power who has stood guard over humanity since its weakest moment.
A supreme unity formation used by the Seamless Gate, allowing hundreds of Empyrean Gods and True Immortals to merge their power and fight on par with a True God or Daofather.
The commander of the Seamless Gate's pursuit squad; a being of immense power and rage with balls of flame for eyes.
A fierce, battle-hardened female Empyrean God and the adopted daughter of Suiren. She is dispatched at the head of a powerful legion to rescue Ji Ning.
An Innate Supreme Treasure and the Seamless Gate's answer to the Void Boat; a flying treasure of immense speed capable of tearing through the void.
A terrifying and reclusive demonic Daofather who owns a powerful Chaos Treasure in the form of a pair of gloves, making her a figure of great power even the Godking fears to command.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is Suiren a real mythological figure?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Yes! Suiren (燧人氏) is a foundational figure in Chinese mythology, revered as the 'Driller of Wood for Fire' and the first of the Three Sovereigns who brought the gift of civilization to humanity.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why is the Seamless Gate's chase failing?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The Void Boat and the Heavenly Witch Shuttle have nearly identical speed and spatial capabilities. The chase fails because the Nuwa Alliance's intelligence network (Patriarch Subhuti's Dream of the Three Realms) gave Ji Ning enough warning to escape the initial trap by a single split-second.
